title: Covenant of the Other Shore
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to leave the Forbidden Grounds, he suddenly sensed a faint aura approaching from the direction of the distant Tianqing Hall—that was Ling Yuan's unique presence. The old sect master coming here at night was by no means a coincidence.

text.content: The Forbidden Grounds of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain were perpetually shrouded in mist, ancient pines and cypresses casting mottled shadows under the moonlight. The cold wind swept through, carrying a faint scent of decay, as if reminding every intruder that this place held countless untold secrets. Chen Ji followed half a step behind Su Qingyao, his gaze sweeping the surroundings without moving, carving every hidden corner into his memory. Though he posed as a废物 throughout the world, he never fought without preparation. Mo Xiansheng's voice whispered in his mind: "This woman is not simple. Be careful."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stopped before a boulder and turned to face Chen Ji, moonlight illuminating her grave expression: "Chen Ji, do you know what kind of existence you've provoked?" Her voice was extremely low, as if fearing the night wind would scatter it, "I've been searching for you for a long time—not as the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, but under another identity." Her fingertips trembled slightly—this was the first time Chen Ji had seen her show such an obvious flaw.

text.content: Chen Ji maintained a humble posture, but beneath his eyes, undercurrents churned. He observed Su Qingyao's fingers tightening slightly within her sleeve—a habitual movement of someone who had been under prolonged tension. She was far from being as composed as she appeared. The four words "another identity" were like a key, opening a door that had been sealed for ages. Mo Xiansheng had mentioned that there were more than one holder of the Tianji Record, and that an organization called "the Other Shore" had been searching for these scattered fragments for millennia. Could Su Qingyao have some connection with the Other Shore?

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao took a deep breath, as if making a certain determination: "The Other Shore is a clandestine organization that stands above the three major sects. Named the Other Shore, in truth—it is the executioner placed in the world by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets." Her voice was cold as ice, "They specifically hunt the holders of the Tianji Record, and this has continued for thousands of years." These words were like thunder in Chen Ji's mind, exploding violently. But his face remained unruffled, only in the depths of his pupils, undercurrents churned.

text.content: Moonlight was like frost, falling on Su Qingyao's pale face, reflecting a strange and cold beauty. Her fingers gently brushed the patterns on the stone wall—ancient runes Chen Ji had never seen before—bearing the same brushwork as the fragments on the Tianji Record, as if drawn by the same hand. "The duty of the Other Shore is to eliminate all variables that might interfere with the workings of Heaven's Way." Su Qingyao continued, "And the holders of the Tianji Record are their most desired targets—for to foresee the future itself is the most fatal variable."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared directly into Chen Ji's eyes, revealing a fragile expression for the first time: "And I, was once one of their members." Her voice was calm as water, but deep in her eyes lay boundless anguish, "Three years ago, I was a candidate for an Executive position in the Other Shore. I personally eliminated three holders of the Tianji Record, my hands stained with blood." The night wind passed, lifting a few strands of hair from her brow. In her eyes, there was a trace of barely perceptible sorrow, "Until I discovered a secret—the secret about the true purpose of the Other Shore."

text.content: Chen Ji's heartbeat suddenly accelerated, but his expression remained unruffled. He quickly analyzed every word in Su Qingyao's speech—Executive candidate, three years ago, personally eliminated three holders. If this information was true, Su Qingyao's combat power was absolutely not to be underestimated. And the "secret" she mentioned was the key to tonight. Mo Xiansheng had hinted that the truth of the Tianji Record was far deeper than imagined. So what about the truth of the Other Shore? Was it also related to the Eye of Heavenly Secrets? Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly in his sleeve, he suppressed the churning waves in his heart and waited for Su Qingyao to continue.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's voice dropped even lower: "The Other Shore is merely a chess piece placed by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Throughout history, holders of the Tianji Record have been used as chess pieces toyed within their palms. And I—" her tone suddenly turned ice cold, "I refuse to be anyone's chess piece anymore. Three years ago, I defected from the Other Shore, and since then have become their target for pursuit." She raised her hand, pushing aside the hair from her brow, revealing a faint gray line at her brow center, "This is the mark of the Other Shore, and the reason they hunt me. As long as this mark remains, my whereabouts can be traced by them at any time."

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at that gray line, quickly calculating in his heart. Su Qingyao's brow center spirit mark was indeed eerie, faintly emanating an unsettling aura. If what she said was true, then she was a chess piece abandoned by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets—sharing the same fate as him. But could this be a bitter flesh scheme set up by the Other Shore? He could not rule out this possibility. After all, in this world, no one is entirely trustworthy, and no one is completely untrustworthy. "So," Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice low, "what exactly do you want from me?"

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's proposal for cooperation was tempting, but he well knew there was never a free lunch in this world. The former executioner has now become a defector—what does she truly want from him? Utilitarian or sincere? Chen Ji had to make a judgment with limited information.

choices.description: Before making a final judgment, first understand Su Qingyao's specific conditions and leverage for cooperation. Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will be invincible in a hundred battles.
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence on the Other Shore's internals and potential allies
choices.risk_hint: It might be a bitter flesh scheme; after revealing information, one would be in a passive position

dialogue.content: A gleam of approval flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes: "You are more cautious than I imagined. Good, this is the quality a holder of the Tianji Record should possess." She took an ancient token from her sleeve, "This is a token of the Other Shore. With it, you can summon my help once in critical moments. This is proof of my sincerity." The token was cool to the touch, inscribed with a strange pattern—the flower of the Other Shore.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶以彼岸信物为诚意

choices.text: Ask her to prove her sincerity first
choices.description: Empty words carry no weight; let Su Qingyao first display some core secrets of the Other Shore as a token of allegiance, proving her sincerity and value.
choices.visible_reward: Gain core intelligence on the Other Shore
choices.risk_hint: May destroy the initially established trust

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's gaze slightly contracted, then she revealed a wry smile: "Alright, empty words carry no weight, so of course you wouldn't believe lightly." She took a Jade Slip from her bosom, "This contains information on one of the Three Executives of the Other Shore—the connection between Xuanwu Sect's old sect master Ling Yuan and the Other Shore. He appears to be Tianqing Sect's protector, but in truth has been colluding with the Other Shore for a long time. If you don't believe me, you can verify it yourself."

choices.memory_label: 获得凌渊与彼岸勾结的情报

choices.text: Politely refuse, maintain distance and observe
choices.description: The waters of the Other Shore run too deep; rash cooperation may bring disaster. Temporarily refuse, maintain distance and continue observing Su Qingyao's movements.
choices.risk_hint: May completely lose the chance of allying with Su Qingyao

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's expression slightly stiffened, then recovered its calm: "I understand your concerns. After all, we've only known each other briefly, and you have no reason to trust me." She returned the token to her sleeve, "But I hope you will reconsider. The Other Shore will not spare any holder of the Tianji Record—including you. Within three days, I will wait for you in the small town outside the sect. If you change your mind, you may come find me." With that, she turned and left, her figure appearing especially desolate under the moonlight.

text.content: The moment the token entered his hand, Chen Ji felt a strange power flow into his palm. That power was cold and profound, as if coming from another world. The Other Shore flower pattern on the token glistened with a ghostly glow under the moonlight, eerie and enchanting. "The flower of the Other Shore, the legendary flower that connects the worlds of life and death." Su Qingyao's voice rang in his ear, "The name Other Shore comes from this. They believe that holders of the Tianji Record are heretics who break the boundary between life and death and must be eliminated." The night wind blew, lifting Su Qingyao's long hair. Standing under the moonlight, she was beautiful as a painting, yet emanating an indescribable sorrow.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stepped forward, less than three feet from Chen Ji. She stared directly into his eyes: "Chen Ji, I know it's hard for you to trust me." Her voice was gentle, yet exceptionally firm, "But I have no more retreat. Those who betray the Other Shore have only one ending—death. I place my bet on you because I believe you can break all this." In her eyes, there was a barely perceptible gleam, "Holders of the Tianji Record are never chess pieces of Heaven's Way—but the chess players."

text.content: Chen Ji fell into brief silence. Su Qingyao's words were like a key, opening a door in his heart that had been tightly shut. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets, the Other Shore, the Tianji Record—these names were like puzzle pieces, gradually outlining a massive conspiracy. He thought of his sister Chen Nian, missing for many years; he thought of Mo Xiansheng's hesitations; he thought of the various dangers encountered along this journey. If Su Qingyao's words were true, then this game was far grander than he had imagined. "So," Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice calm, "what you want is—to break the control of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao nodded: "Exactly. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets treats all of us as chess pieces—including the Executives of the Other Shore, the high-ranking members of the three major sects, and even those so-called genius disciples." Her voice carried a hint of mockery, "Only the holders of the Tianji Record have the chance to see through all this. I need your power to break this predicament, and you—also need my intelligence to cope with the upcoming crisis." Her gaze held a hint of sincerity, "Each takes what it needs, mutual benefit. This is the cooperation I propose."

text.content: Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly in his sleeve. Mo Xiansheng's voice whispered in his mind: "What this woman says is not false, but there's no need to fully trust. Cooperation is possible, but trust is premature." He took a deep breath, weighing the pros and cons. The intelligence Su Qingyao provided was indeed enticing—the Other Shore's mode of operation, the identities of the Three Executives, Ling Yuan's collusion with the Other Shore—these pieces of information, if verified, would become important leverage in his hand. But he also clearly understood that allying with Su Qingyao meant officially stepping into this deep water. "Very well." Chen Ji spoke, his voice low and calm, "I agree to cooperate with you. But I have conditions."

choice.prompt: The cooperation is set, but Chen Ji will not put himself in a passive position. He needs to add his own leverage to the agreement, ensuring that even if Su Qingyao has ulterior motives, he can remain invincible.

choices.text: Demand all intelligence on the Other Shore
choices.description: Su Qingyao must truthfully disclose all intelligence on the Other Shore, including detailed information on the Three Executives, the Other Shore's mode of operation, and all the secrets she knows. Information must be exchanged equally.
choices.visible_cost: Requires paying a corresponding price in exchange
choices.visible_reward: Gain core intelligence on the Other Shore, seize information advantage

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao nodded without hesitation: "Of course. I will tell you everything I know—the history of the Other Shore, the combat power and weaknesses of the Three Executives, the Other Shore's methods of pursuit, and most importantly—the true purpose of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets." She took out a Jade Slip from her sleeve, "This contains all the intelligence I've gathered over these three years. From tonight onward, we are allies—advance together, live and die together."

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶达成情报共享协议

choices.description: Chen Nian is his greatest weakness and the most important reason he agreed to cooperate. He asks Su Qingyao to use the Other Shore's intelligence network to help investigate his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts.
choices.visible_cost: Expose the existence of his sister
choices.visible_reward: Gain clues to finding his sister
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may use Chen Nian as leverage

dialogue.content: Upon hearing the name "Chen Nian," Su Qingyao's expression changed slightly. A complex gleam flickered in her gaze, as if hesitating about something. After a moment, she slowly spoke: "Chen Nian... I seem to have heard this name somewhere before." Her brow furrowed tightly, "Give me some time, I will use all my connections to investigate. If she truly has any connection to the Other Shore, I will definitely find her."

choices.memory_label: 托付寻找妹妹的希望给苏青瑶

dialogue.content: A gleam of surprise flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes, then calm returned: "Very well, our agreement is sealed." She turned to leave, but after several steps, she suddenly stopped. She looked back at Chen Ji, moonlight illuminating the complex expression on her face. "Chen Ji, one last thing." Her voice suddenly became somewhat ethereal, "Among the Other Shore, the highest in status are the 'Three Executives.' They each control different powers, and one of them—" she paused, a shadow passing through her eyes, "one of them has countless connections with Tianqing Sect's old sect master Ling Yuan."

text.content: These words were like a heavy hammer, slamming hard on Chen Ji's heart. Ling Yuan! That old sect master who appeared to shelter him but in truth harbored malicious intent, actually had dealings with the Other Shore? Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, but he quickly suppressed the turbulent waves in his heart, his expression calm. "You mean, Ling Yuan—" he deliberately left the sentence half-spoken, waiting for Su Qingyao's answer. The night wind blew again, bringing a chill. Su Qingyao turned and faced his eyes: "I'm only reminding you to be careful. Before you become strong enough, don't let him discover your secret." The words fell, and her figure had already vanished into the night. Moonlight was like water, falling on Chen Ji's cold expression. In the depths of his eyes, a cold gleam flickered—that was the coldness and sharpness belonging to a chess player. Ling Yuan, the Other Shore, the Three Executives—this game was getting more and more interesting.
